action.command:
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh create realms -s realm=my-realm -s enabled=true 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "REALM_EXIT:$?"
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh create clients -r my-realm -s clientId=strassennamen -s enabled=true -s publicClient=true -s 'redirectUris=["http://localhost:4200/*","http://localhost:5000/*"]' -s 'webOrigins=["http://localhost:4200"]' -s 'rootUrl=http://localhost:4200' -s 'baseUrl=http://localhost:4200' -s 'postLogoutRedirectUris=["http://localhost:4200/*"]' -s 'standardFlowEnabled=true' -s 'directAccessGrantsEnabled=true' -s 'implicitFlowEnabled=true' 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "CLIENT_EXIT:$?"
